_doc: Short company descriptions written by Claude from general knowledge, used only when a company's own postings don't include an 'About us' section (D-065). Shown in the app labelled 'Summary by Claude'. Keep them factual and short; correct them when a company's own text becomes available.

companies.AMD: Semiconductor company that designs CPUs, GPUs and AI accelerators for PCs, data centres and gaming. Its Markham (Toronto area) site came from the ATI acquisition and is one of its largest engineering hubs.
companies.Apple: Consumer technology company behind the iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch and services such as the App Store, iCloud and Apple Pay. Has offices in Toronto, Vancouver and Montreal.
companies.Aritzia: Vancouver-based fashion retailer with boutiques across North America and a large e-commerce business; its technology and product teams support stores, online and supply chain.
companies.Atlassian: Software company behind Jira, Confluence, Trello and Loom, used by teams to plan, track and collaborate on work. Remote-first, with employees across Canada.
companies.Beacon Software: Builds and acquires vertical software businesses, giving acquired companies shared operating, product and AI expertise.
companies.Bell: Canada's largest communications company (BCE): wireless, internet, TV and media (Bell Media), plus business and cloud services.
companies.BlackBerry: Waterloo-founded software company focused on cybersecurity and on QNX, embedded software used in cars and industrial systems.
companies.Block (Square / Cash App): Financial technology company behind Square (payments and tools for sellers), Cash App (consumer finance), Afterpay and TIDAL. Has a Toronto presence.
companies.CIBC: One of Canada's five largest banks, offering personal, business, wealth and capital markets services, headquartered in Toronto.
companies.Canada Life: Major Canadian insurer offering life and health insurance, group benefits, retirement and wealth products; part of Great-West Lifeco.
companies.Coveo: Quebec City and Montreal-based company whose AI search, recommendations and generative answering platform powers commerce sites, service portals and workplaces.
companies.Desjardins: Canada's largest financial cooperative, headquartered in Quebec, offering banking, insurance, wealth management and business services.
companies.Dye & Durham: Toronto-based provider of practice management and search software for legal and financial professionals, grown largely through acquisitions.
companies.EQ Bank: Digital bank from Equitable Bank, Canada's 'challenger bank', offering high-interest savings, GICs and mortgages online.
companies.Ecobee (Generac): Toronto company behind ecobee smart thermostats, sensors and home security; part of Generac, a home energy company.
companies.Fintel Connect: Vancouver-based platform that helps banks and fintechs run partner and affiliate marketing for financial products.
companies.Google: Alphabet's main business: Search, Ads, YouTube, Android, Chrome, Google Cloud and Gemini. Has large engineering offices in Toronto, Waterloo and Montreal.
companies.Instacart: Grocery technology company: online grocery delivery and pickup, plus an enterprise platform and ads business for retailers and brands. Large Toronto presence.
companies.Intact: Canada's largest property and casualty insurer (home, auto and business insurance), with a strong data science and AI lab.
companies.Jane App: Vancouver-based practice management software (booking, charting, billing) for health and wellness clinics.
companies.Kinaxis: Ottawa-based supply chain planning software company; its Maestro platform helps manufacturers plan supply and demand.
companies.Loopio: Toronto-based software for responding to RFPs and security questionnaires, using AI to draft answers from a content library.
companies.Mastercard: Global payments network and technology company, with a Vancouver tech hub and offices in Toronto.
companies.Meta: Company behind Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger, plus Reality Labs and Meta AI; has engineering in Toronto.
companies.Microsoft: Software and cloud company: Azure, Microsoft 365, Windows, GitHub, LinkedIn, Xbox and Copilot. Has offices in Toronto, Vancouver and Montreal.
companies.Mila: Quebec's AI research institute in Montreal, founded by Yoshua Bengio; works with universities and industry on deep learning research and applied AI.
companies.Moneris: One of Canada's largest payment processors (owned by RBC and BMO), providing card terminals and online payments to merchants.
companies.National Bank: Canada's sixth-largest bank, headquartered in Montreal, with personal, commercial, wealth and capital markets businesses.
companies.OMERS: Pension plan for Ontario municipal employees and one of Canada's largest institutional investors, with technology and investment teams in Toronto.
companies.Okta: Identity and access management company: single sign-on, multi-factor authentication and identity security for workforces and customers. Has a Toronto office.
companies.PolicyMe: Ottawa-based insurtech selling life and health insurance online in Canada.
companies.Qualcomm: Semiconductor company known for Snapdragon mobile chips, wireless technology (5G) and on-device AI; has Canadian engineering sites.
companies.Questrade: Toronto-based online brokerage and fintech offering self-directed investing, robo-advice, and banking products (Questbank).
companies.Ratehub: Toronto-based comparison site and broker for mortgages, credit cards, insurance and banking products in Canada.
companies.Rogers: One of Canada's largest communications and media companies: wireless, cable and internet, sports (Toronto Blue Jays) and media.
companies.Samsung AI Center: Samsung Research's AI labs, including a Toronto centre working on on-device AI and machine learning for Samsung products.
companies.Scotiabank: One of Canada's five largest banks, headquartered in Toronto, with major operations across the Americas.
companies.ServiceNow: Enterprise workflow software company whose platform automates IT, HR and customer service work, increasingly with AI agents. Has offices in Montreal and Toronto.
companies.Shopify: Canadian commerce company: the platform millions of businesses use to sell online and in person, plus payments, shipping and AI tools.
companies.Waabi: Toronto-based autonomous trucking company led by Raquel Urtasun, building AI driving systems trained largely in simulation.
companies.Workday: Enterprise cloud software for HR, finance and planning, increasingly with AI agents; has a large Vancouver office.
